description: Xena begins her attempt at redemption with Gabrielle beside her, confronting warlords, gods and people harmed by the kind of violence she once commanded.

s01e01.description: In “Sins Of The Past”, Xena and Gabrielle face a new conflict shaped by myth, war or Xena’s past, testing how far redemption can survive the consequences of violence.
